messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1799123456 - spike in rate-limiter errors (429s) across rlv2 canary. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC12345

alice: paging @oncall-eng — seeing 5xx/429 spikes in prod, canary region us-west-2. customers getting quota errors even with exemptions.

sanjay: on it, joining. which rollout touched rate-limiter?

alice: rlv2 enforcement rollout deployed ~12m ago (canary). config PR: https://git.example/r/rlv2/PR-842. looks like exemption table didn't load for a subset of requests.

marie: logs show missing exemption header -> token_accounting layer returns default quota. sample: `{"user":"acct-123","exempt":false,"quota":100}` when it should be `true`.

kevin: I can flip the feature flag for enforcement immediately. asking for mitigation plan: rollback canary or kill-switch?

support-led: support reports ~12 customers with elevated errors, 3 enterprise customers affected (AcmeCorp, NovaPay, Streamly). customers are seeing 429s on embedding endpoints.

alice: timeline: deploy->12m->errors. suggest feature-flag kill-switch first (fast), then rollback if needed.

ops-bot: command output: `feature_flag status rlv2_enforce = true (canary: us-west-2)`

kevin: executing kill-switch: `bin/ff-toggle --env=prod --flag=rlv2_enforce --state=off --scope=canary-us-west-2`

ops-bot: executed by kevin at 1799123520: success. `rlv2_enforce` = false for canary-us-west-2.

chris: metrics: error rate dropped 65% in the last 90s, token accounting errors down to baseline. still seeing edge cases for long-lived connections.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for rlv2-canary -> rolling back to previous revision (rev: c3f2a) at 1799123548.

alice: good. support, please validate customer-side and give list of impacted customers for postmortem priority.

support-led: validated: AcmeCorp (10k requests/min) had ~9% 429s over 10m window; NovaPay had transactions retried but no data loss; Streamly saw streaming connection resets. open ticket numbers: #5678, #5679, #5680.

sanjay: root cause hypothesis: PR-842 changed the exemption merge order in token_accounting incautiously — fallback defaulted to non-exempt for certain routing paths (split-path optimization). will revert config merge and add unit + integration tests.

oncall-eng: taking the incident for postmortem. current state: mitigation applied (flag off + canary rollback), error volume returned to normal at 1799123605. will keep monitoring for 2 hours.

alice: kudos to team for quick action. action items: (1) revert PR-842 merge logic and add tests (owner: sanjay), (2) add smoke-test that seeds exemption table during canary startup (owner: marie), (3) telemetry: add an alert for exemption-mismatch ratio > 0.5% (owner: chris), (4) customer comms draft (owner: support-led).

kevin: I'll follow up with a runbook update: include ff-toggle steps and rollback checklist.

support-led: drafting customer comms now, will post in #customer-impact and start outreach for the 3 affected enterprises.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1799123456 -> mitigated (flag off + rollback). Severity: Sev2. Assigned: oncall-eng. Postmortem ETA: 72h.

oncall-eng: handing off monitoring to day-shift at 1799123668. leaving notes in ops runbook and will add timestamps/metrics to the postmortem.

alice: thanks everyone — save logs and timeline fragments to the incident doc.

kevin: quick snippet for postmortem repro:```
// reproduce missing exemption
curl -H "X-User: acct-123" -H "X-Path: split-a" https://inference.prod/api/v1/embed
// observe token_accounting: exempt=false
```

chris: capturing graphs and will attach to the postmortem. assigning follow-ups in Jira: RL-1352 RL-1353 RL-1354.

support-led: closing customer tickets after outreach, will update incident doc with templates.

alice: closing thread here, move any new updates into the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
